description: Sends a homeowner repair request to Roger, which matches one vetted local pro. Returns a confirm_url where the homeowner confirms and books on rogerrepair.com. Requires homeowner_confirmed=true. Emails at example.com run in test mode: nothing is saved.

email.description: Homeowner's email. Roger sends booking updates here.

homeowner_confirmed.description: True when the homeowner has reviewed these details and asked for the request to be sent.

phone.description: Optional. Homeowner phone so the pro can reach them.

postal_code.description: US 5-digit ZIP (e.g. 33133) or Canadian postal code (e.g. M5V 2T6) where the work is.

problem.description: The homeowner's problem in plain words, e.g. 'Kitchen sink is leaking under the cabinet'.

name: request_booking
title: Send a repair request
